meaning: The chromosome region associated with the attachment and separation of sister chromatids.
example: Sister chromatids remain linked at a constricted chromosome region before division.
importantDistinction: Counting separated centromere units helps distinguish chromosomes from chromatids.
whatItDoes: Sister chromatids remain linked at a constricted chromosome region before division.
feature: Sister chromatids remain linked at a constricted chromosome region before division.
confusion: Counting separated centromere units helps distinguish chromosomes from chromatids.

meaning: The count of individual chromosomes in a specified cell or nucleus.
example: A diploid model cell retains four chromosomes after replication until sister chromatids separate.
importantDistinction: Always state which cell, nucleus or pole is being counted.
whatItDoes: A diploid model cell retains four chromosomes after replication until sister chromatids separate.
feature: A diploid model cell retains four chromosomes after replication until sister chromatids separate.
confusion: Always state which cell, nucleus or pole is being counted.

meaning: The quantity of DNA in the specified cell or nucleus.
example: The DNA quantity doubles during S phase before the cell divides.
importantDistinction: DNA amount can change while chromosome number stays the same.
whatItDoes: The DNA quantity doubles during S phase before the cell divides.
feature: The DNA quantity doubles during S phase before the cell divides.
confusion: DNA amount can change while chromosome number stays the same.

meaning: The mitotic stage in which sister chromatids separate and move toward opposite poles.
example: Copied chromosome units become independent chromosomes as they separate.
importantDistinction: The whole-cell chromosome count briefly increases before cytokinesis.
whatItDoes: Copied chromosome units become independent chromosomes as they separate.
feature: Copied chromosome units become independent chromosomes as they separate.
confusion: The whole-cell chromosome count briefly increases before cytokinesis.

meaning: The mitotic stage in which chromosomes condense and the division machinery becomes organized.
example: Condensed replicated chromosomes become visible as spindle structures develop.
importantDistinction: DNA replication precedes prophase in the normal cycle.
whatItDoes: Condensed replicated chromosomes become visible as spindle structures develop.
feature: Condensed replicated chromosomes become visible as spindle structures develop.
confusion: DNA replication precedes prophase in the normal cycle.

meaning: The mitotic stage in which replicated chromosomes align at the cell equator.
example: Replicated chromosomes line up individually across the middle of the cell.
importantDistinction: Homologous pairs do not normally align as tetrads in mitotic metaphase.
whatItDoes: Replicated chromosomes line up individually across the middle of the cell.
feature: Replicated chromosomes line up individually across the middle of the cell.
confusion: Homologous pairs do not normally align as tetrads in mitotic metaphase.

meaning: A microtubule structure involved in chromosome attachment and movement during division.
example: Fibres from opposite poles attach to the replicated chromosome’s kinetochore regions.
importantDistinction: Spindle attachment guides chromosome movement; it does not create new DNA.
whatItDoes: Fibres from opposite poles attach to the replicated chromosome’s kinetochore regions.
feature: Fibres from opposite poles attach to the replicated chromosome’s kinetochore regions.
confusion: Spindle attachment guides chromosome movement; it does not create new DNA.

meaning: The mitotic stage in which chromosome groups reach the poles and daughter nuclei form.
example: Nuclear envelopes reform around the two chromosome groups.
importantDistinction: Cytokinesis is a separate, coordinated division of the cytoplasm.
whatItDoes: Nuclear envelopes reform around the two chromosome groups.
feature: Nuclear envelopes reform around the two chromosome groups.
confusion: Cytokinesis is a separate, coordinated division of the cytoplasm.
